- **Branch:** `devin/p31-14-presentation-analytics-from-export`
- **Config:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/P31.14__presentation-analytics-from-export.md live_verification=false`.

## Deferrals read

- **D-P27.5-1** — this ticket owns closure: "either emit the map density-bins +
  network centrality/ER-quality analytics into the export, OR ratify them as
  presentation-only". Answered: **export-emitted** (ADR-117).
- **D-P30.3-3** — this ticket owns the export/engineering half; the public
  surface half is owed to P31.16 (row 157). Stays OPEN, annotated.
- **CROSS-CUTTING INVARIANTS** re-checked: named denominators (SIG-METRIC-008 —
  `is_population_total: false` on every file); compartment separation
  (`assert_separated` re-proven over the analytics placements); coordinate
  reduction (tier-0 only, reduced coordinates before any aggregation); zero-JS
  public pages (no client JS added); fixtures remain the CI default.
- **OUT OF SCOPE** re-checked: no tiles work (P31.15), no hosted re-export /
  republish (P31.16), no new analytics beyond the listed set.

## Requirements (from the spec)

1. A new export-emitted family `web/analytics/<name>.json` — **not** the
   demo-guarded `web/presentation/` — each file with a schema id, `as_of`, a
   named denominator, and its source compartments. Definitions: density bins
   (grid + zoom semantics, tier-0 points only, coordinate-reduced §19.4);
   network centrality (the named measure + the focus-entity rule); the watch's
   tracked decision point; per-surface provenance summaries; evidence tiers
   W1–W3 for "How we know this".
2. Producers in `exports` reading the materialized graph, deterministic for one
   snapshot; each file lands in the compartment its inputs allow; a
   mixed-licence file is refused by `assert_separated`.
3. Web: switch the getters to the fixtures|export fail-loud pattern; delete the
   overlay's coverage of them; keep zero-JS.
4. Tests: deterministic, licence-separated; a build with an analytics file
   removed exits 1; `publish` accepts `web/analytics/` and refuses
   `web/presentation/`; seeded real-PG export renders every analytic.
5. ADR-R9-ANALYTICS with `## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row; D-P27.5-1 →
   DONE; D-P30.3-3 annotated (surface half → P31.16).

- [x] `npm --prefix web run check` + `make check` green

## What landed

### `exports/src/exports/analytics.py` (new, ~740 lines)

Pure producers over the shaped snapshot + supplementary reads — one module, one
`build_analytics()` entry returning five `AnalyticsArtifact`s:

| file | content | denominator (example) |
|---|---|---|
| `density_bins.json` | H3 res-3 bins over published tier-0 points; `coverage` = distinct named sources per cell (≥3 high / 2 partial / 1 low) — low coverage never reads as low density | "N published observation-level site records with a releasable tier-0 point (licence-refused subjects excluded)" |
| `centrality.json` | undirected degree over the SAME typed access edges `web/network.json` emits (materialized `relationship` rows first, shaping fallback); statistics sorted (−degree, id); `focus` = max degree, ties lexical; `er_quality: null` + the inline no-ER-eval disclosure | "N typed access edges between M entities in the exported sharing network" |
| `decision_point.json` | the earliest derivable `next_decision_date` across `contract_watch` — the same `resolveTermination`/`nextDecisionDate` rule the web renders (expiry − notice window if auto-renewing, else expiry); `null` when none is derivable | "N contracts on the renewal watch" |
| `provenance.json` | the three `ProvenanceSummary` blocks (site / corrections / research_queue); site `tier_distribution` = real §10.6 `weight_class` over the publishable claims (R base, D/I/C deltas, D6 excluded, C derived per predicate half-life at `as_of`), unweightable → `untiered`; `human_review_status` from the camera-site run summary | "N publishable claims across M named sources" |
| `queue_meta.json` | `queue_as_of` + `jurisdiction_claims` (`[]` today — the claim spine does not carry community-curation state; the denominator says so) | "N research tasks; jurisdiction claims are … the claim spine does not carry" |

Licence labelling follows `web/map.json` exactly: a SIG-derivable `CC-BY-4.0`
file lands in `web`; any other label — single ODbL or a compound `A AND B` —
files in `web_mixed` (restricted: a build input of the produced-work site,
never a public download). `assert_analytics_separated` re-proves one licence
per compartment via `exports.compartments.assert_separated`.

### `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`

- New `claim_weights` supplementary query (tier-0, live, redistributable claims
  with their §10.4–§10.6 axes + effective licence — the same snapshot feeding
  both the tier distribution and centrality's source compartments).
- `build_spine_export` calls `analytics.build_analytics(...)` with
  `slices.licences_by_subject` / `slices.refused_subjects`, the materialized
  edges and site-run summaries, and the ruleset version; emits the artifacts
  into `web_artifacts` with per-file licence + compartment manifest entries.
- `_extended_manifest` accepts `web_compartments` so a `web_mixed` analytic is
  filed restricted, not under the CC-BY `web` compartment.

### `web/src/lib/data.ts`

- New `readAnalytics(name, pick)` — reads `<exportDir>/web/analytics/<name>.json`,
  validates the envelope (`schema`/`as_of`/`denominator`/`source_compartments`),
  **throws on a missing or malformed artifact** (the same fail-loud posture as
  the nine P27.1 getters — never demo, never a silent empty state).
- All nine analytic getters rewired: `getMapDensityBins`, `getNetworkCentrality`,
  `getNetworkFocusEntityId`, `getDecisionPoint`, `getSiteProvenance`,
  `getCorrectionsProvenance`, `getResearchQueueProvenance`,
  `getJurisdictionClaims`, `getQueueAsOf`.
- `readPresentation` survives only for `jurisdiction_dossiers` (the
  deliberately-demo SIG-PUB-017 dossiers; `ops/publish.py` still refuses the
  whole `web/presentation/` tree).
- `CentralityStatistic.er_quality` widened to `ErQuality | null`;
  `assertErDisclosures` still requires the inline disclosure — a null is
  admissible only with the statement that the measure does not rest on a
  probabilistic ER eval.

### `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts`

Emits the five `web/analytics/` envelopes carrying the committed fixture values
(same fixture-mode output as before), so `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` exercised
against the fixture bundle runs the new seam end-to-end; still writes the demo
`jurisdiction_dossiers` overlay.

### `ops/src/ops/publish.py` — unchanged by design

`assert_export_present` already refuses `web/presentation/`; `partition_export`
+ `restriction_reason` classify `web/analytics/` paths like every other
manifest artifact (single known licence in a declared compartment → public;
compound label / `web_mixed` → restricted). Tests added, no code change needed.

### Dependency

`h3==4.5.0` added to `exports/pyproject.toml` (+ `uv.lock`, `pylock.toml`
regenerated; a `tool.mypy` `ignore_missing_imports` override — the package
ships no stubs).

## Deviations

- `ops/publish.py` needed no code change — the P30.3 presentation refusal and
  the data-driven partition already cover the new family; tests pin it.
- The two near-boundary H3 res-3 points in the unit test share a cell at
  ~600 m (verified deterministic); the assertion is over the merged
  `deviceCount`, not a guessed cell id.
- `decision_point`/`queue_meta`/`provenance` surface `null`/`[]`/`untiered`
  honestly when the spine carries no `contract_watch`, no jurisdiction claims,
  or no weightable claims — honest absence inside a real artifact, never a
  fabricated figure.
